description: Search US federal recreation facilities — campgrounds, day-use areas, visitor centers, trailheads — on Recreation.gov. Filter by name/keyword, state, activity (e.g. "camping", "hiking"), or geographic radius. Returns facility IDs, names, types, phone/email, and coordinates. Example: search_facilities({ query: "Yosemite", state: "CA", activity: "camping" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Recreation.gov RIDB API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

activity.description: Activity name to filter by, e.g. "camping", "hiking", "fishing"

latitude.description: Latitude for geographic search (use with longitude + radius)

longitude.description: Longitude for geographic search (use with latitude + radius)

query.description: Keyword or name to search, e.g. "Yosemite", "Pinnacles"

radius.description: Search radius in miles around latitude/longitude

name: search_facilities
title: Search Facilities
